verdict.rationale: Pipedrive's homepage says users can 'manage deals with AI' inside the CRM, which glancingly supports in-product AI assistance. Nothing documents AI-generated insights or suggestions specifically. The MCP server's 'get insights' happens in an external AI assistant, not inside the product, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented in-product AI insight or suggestion features (e.g. deal recommendations, summaries, next-best actions), detail on what the AI surfaces from user data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
